pages.text: A Portable Akaishi Cell is a portable energy buffer.$(br2)$(bold)Three tiers$(reset) (capacity / per-tick charge and output):$(li)Basic: 50 million / 500 thousand$(li)Advanced: 200 million / 1 million$(li)Super: 1 billion / 4 million$(br2)$(bold)Usage:$(reset) carry it in the inventory. Akaishi curios automatically draw power from Portable Cells in the inventory when their own buffer is depleted; equipped Akaishi gear is also repaired. Details follow on the next page.

$(bold)Auto-repair:$(reset) a Portable Cell in the inventory continuously repairs Akaishi gear worn or held:$(li)Basic: 10 durability per tick$(li)Advanced: 20 durability per tick$(li)Super: 40 durability per tick$(br2)Each point of durability costs $(bold)100 AE$(reset). Multiple cells combine their power; when one is depleted, the next is used automatically.$(br2)$(bold)Recharging:$(reset) place the Portable Cell in the charge slot of an $(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Energy Cell$(/l) interface.

The Portable Cell is the mobile variant of the block-sized Energy Cells; capacities are listed in $(l:akaishi:energy_basics)Akaishi Energy Basics$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Energy Storage$(/l). It is used with $(l:akaishi:equipment)Equipment$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:curios)Akaishi Trinkets$(/l).
